ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms flaky cases, quarantine owners and the silent-quarantine flag are declared; it does not run the tests.
offer: Track intermittent failures with an owner and a visible quarantine reason. Quarantine contains unreliable signal; it does not erase the failure or close the underlying defect.

minimal.reason: List the tests known to be flaky. Unlisted flakes keep poisoning signal, so name each case.

mid.reason: Assign an owner to each quarantined test. Unowned quarantines never get fixed, so name a person or team.

maximal.reason: Set silent quarantine to false. A hidden quarantine erases the failure and leaves the defect open, so record the reason visibly.
